<h3><strong>Implementation Steps for Odoo:</strong></h3>
<ol>
<li><strong>Create Pages:</strong>
<ul>
<li>Use Odoo’s website builder to create each page type (Home, Services, About Us, etc.).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Add Blocks:</strong>
<ul>
<li>Drag and drop Odoo blocks (e.g., hero banners, feature grids, contact forms).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Customize Content:</strong>
<ul>
<li>Populate blocks with your repository content.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Set Up Navigation:</strong>
<ul>
<li>Organize the menu to reflect the tree structure.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Link Legal Pages:</strong>
<ul>
<li>Add Terms &amp; Conditions and Privacy Policy to the footer.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Optimize for Mobile:</strong>
<ul>
<li>Ensure all pages are responsive.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Test &amp; Publish:</strong>
<ul>
<li>Review and publish your site.</li>
</ul>

<h3><strong>Prompt for AI/Developer:</strong></h3>

<h2><strong>Step 2: Create a GitHub Repository</strong></h2>
<h3><strong>2.1 Create a New Repository on GitHub</strong></h3>
<ol>
<li>Go to <a href="https://github.com" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer external" class="">GitHub</a> and log in.</li>
<li>Click the <strong>+</strong> icon in the top-right corner and select <strong><span data-question="What are the benefits of creating a new repository on GitHub?" class="followup-block cursor-pointer outline-none static -mx-0.5 inline px-0.5 group-hover/message:[--hover-opacity:1]" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="radix-«Rh1vba0lnad9tmr6mqmdb»" data-state="closed" tabindex="0" style="--underline-opacity:0.2;--underline-height:0%;--underline-saturation:0">New repository</span></strong>.</li>
<li>Enter a name for your repository (e.g., <code class="">bymb-odoo-xml-generator</code>).</li>
<li>Choose <strong>Public</strong> or <strong>Private</strong>.</li>
<li>Click <strong>Create repository</strong>.</li>
</ol>
<hr/>
<h3><strong>2.2 Link Your Local Repository to GitHub</strong></h3>
<p dir="auto" class="whitespace-break-spaces">Copy the <span data-question="What is a remote repository?" class="followup-block cursor-pointer outline-none static -mx-0.5 inline px-0.5 group-hover/message:[--hover-opacity:1]" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="radix-«Ribba0lnad9tmr6mqmdb»" data-state="closed" tabindex="0" style="--underline-opacity:0.2;--underline-height:0%;--underline-saturation:0">remote repository</span> URL from GitHub (e.g., <code class="">https://github.com/your-username/bymb-odoo-xml-generator.git</code>).</p>
<p dir="auto" class="whitespace-break-spaces">Run the following commands in your terminal:</p>
<pre><div class="relative m-0 rounded-md border border-default bg-[#1e1e1e] whitespace-break-spaces dark:bg-subtle"><div data-exclude-copy="true" class="sticky top-0 mb-1 flex items-center justify-end gap-1 rounded-t-md bg-[#1e1e1e] px-2 font-sans select-none dark:bg-subtle"><button class="disabled:pointer-auto focus-visible:outline-hidden items-center justify-center whitespace-nowrap rounded-md font-normal transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:size-4 [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 disabled:text-hint flex h-auto gap-1.5 px-1 py-2 text-xs text-inverted-muted hover:bg-none! </span>
<span></span><span class="token" style="color:#6a9955"># Push your code to GitHub</span><span>
</span><span></span><span class="token" style="color:#dcdcaa">git</span><span> push -u origin main</span></code></div></div></pre>

<hr/>
<h2><strong>Usage</strong></h2>
<ol>
<li>Select a page from the dropdown menu.</li>
<li>Click <strong>Generate Odoo XML</strong> to create the XML template.</li>
<li>Use the <strong>Copy</strong> or <strong>Download</strong> buttons to save the XML.</li>
<li>Toggle between <strong>Preview</strong> and <strong>XML</strong> views.</li>
</ol>
<hr/>
<h2><strong>Odoo Implementation</strong></h2>
<ol>
<li>Save the generated XML to your Odoo module&#x27;s <code class="">views/</code> folder.</li>
<li>Add the template ID to your module&#x27;s <code class="">__manifest__.py</code>.</li>
<li>Create corresponding menu items in the <code class="">data/</code> folder.</li>
<li>Update your module and restart Odoo.</li>
<li>Activate the pages in <strong>Website Settings</strong>.</li>
</ol>
<hr/>
<h2><strong>Dependencies</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>React</li>
<li>Lucide React (for icons)</li>
<li>Bootstrap 4 (included in Odoo templates)</li>
<li>Font Awesome (included in Odoo templates)</li>
</ul>

<h3><strong>D. UI Rendering</strong></h3>
<p dir="auto" class="whitespace-break-spaces">The component renders:</p>
<ol>
<li>A <strong>page selector</strong> dropdown.</li>
<li><strong>Buttons</strong> to generate, copy, download, and toggle preview.</li>
<li>A <strong>preview section</strong> to display either the content or generated XML.</li>

<h2><strong>4. Does Your Code Contain Comprehensive Details?</strong></h2>
<p dir="auto" class="whitespace-break-spaces"><strong>Yes!</strong> Your <code class="">OdooXMLGenerator.js</code> file is <span data-question="What are the advantages and disadvantages of keeping the project in a single file versus splitting it into multiple files?" class="followup-block cursor-pointer outline-none static -mx-0.5 inline px-0.5 group-hover/message:[--hover-opacity:1]" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="radix-«R1crba8lnad9tmr6mqmdb»" data-state="closed" tabindex="0" style="--underline-opacity:0.2;--underline-height:0%;--underline-saturation:0"><strong>self-contained</strong> and includes</span>:</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>All data</strong> for BY MB Consultancy (company info, pages, sections).</li>
<li><strong>Logic</strong> to generate Odoo-compatible XML for each page.</li>
<li><strong>UI components</strong> to preview, copy, and download the XML.</li>
<li><strong>Instructions</strong> for Odoo implementation.</li>
</ol>

<li><strong>Add more pages</strong> or sections if needed.</li>

<li><strong>Add tests</strong> to ensure the generated XML is valid.</li>
</ol>

</ul>
